disclaimer: Intervals are typical values from manufacturer schedules and industry guidance. Your owner's manual is the final authority, so edit anything that differs.

templates.title: Engine oil & filter (Ford gas V8/V10)
templates.description: Replace. 2012-2019 F-53 manuals list 7,500 mi / 6 mo. Change at least every 6 mo even if the coach sits.
templates.typicalRange: 5,000-10,000 mi; 6-12 mo (newer F-53 oil-life monitor: up to 10,000 mi or 450 engine hr)
templates.severeService: Default already matches Ford's towing/special-use schedule
templates.source: Ford F-53 & E-Series owner manuals (as quoted on iRV2 / Forest River forums)
templates.notes: Typical: 5,000-10,000 mi; 6-12 mo (newer F-53 oil-life monitor: up to 10,000 mi or 450 engine hr). Severe service: Default already matches Ford's towing/special-use schedule. Source: Ford F-53 & E-Series owner manuals (as quoted on iRV2 / Forest River forums).

templates.title: Engine air filter inspection
templates.description: Inspect. Check at each oil change.
templates.notes: Source: Ford schedule (owner summaries); General practice.

templates.title: Engine air filter replacement
templates.severeService: Dusty conditions: halve the interval
templates.notes: Typical: 15,000-30,000 mi; 2-3 yr. Severe service: Dusty conditions: halve the interval. Source: Ford schedule (owner summaries); General practice.

templates.title: Accessory belt & hoses inspection
templates.description: Inspect. Replace belts or hoses that are cracked, glazed or soft.

templates.title: Engine oil & filter (Cummins diesel)
templates.description: Replace. Most coaches hit the 12-month limit first; oil analysis can justify extending. Verify against your chassis/engine guide.
templates.notes: Typical: 10,000-25,000 mi or 250-500 hr; 12 mo. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Engine air filter restriction check (diesel)
templates.description: Inspect. Replace when the restriction indicator calls for it (typically 12-24 mo).

templates.title: DEF level check
templates.description: Check. 2010+ diesels. Use fresh DEF; it degrades with heat and age. DEF filter per OEM.

templates.title: Engine oil & filter (Ford Transit 3.5L)
templates.description: Replace. A fully built camper van usually counts as severe duty.
templates.typicalRange: Normal 7,500-10,000 mi; severe 5,000-7,500 mi; extreme 3,000-5,000 mi
templates.severeService: Default already uses Ford's severe schedule (heavy load, towing, mountains, idling, temperature extremes)
templates.notes: Typical: Normal 7,500-10,000 mi; severe 5,000-7,500 mi; extreme 3,000-5,000 mi. Severe service: Default already uses Ford's severe schedule (heavy load, towing, mountains, idling, temperature extremes). Source: Ford Transit scheduled maintenance (fordservicecontent.com).

templates.title: Engine oil & filter (Ram ProMaster 3.6L)
templates.typicalRange: Per oil-life monitor, up to ~10,000 mi
templates.severeService: Severe duty: shorten the interval
templates.notes: Typical: Per oil-life monitor, up to ~10,000 mi. Severe service: Severe duty: shorten the interval. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Engine oil & filter (Mercedes Sprinter diesel)
templates.description: Replace. Upfitters often recommend changing sooner than the indicator for camper duty; verify by model year.
templates.notes: Typical: Per ASSYST service indicator (Service A/B). Source: General practice.

templates.title: Coolant condition test
templates.description: Test. Diesels with conventional coolant: also test SCA level.

templates.title: Coolant replacement (Ford Motorcraft)
templates.description: Replace. Confirm the coolant type on the reservoir cap.
templates.notes: Typical: ~100,000 mi first change; 5-6 yr. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Charge-air cooler & radiator fins
templates.description: Inspect and clean. Rear-mounted radiators clog; clean gently.

templates.title: Generator break-in oil change (gasoline)
templates.source: Cummins Onan RV Generator Handbook; Cummins.com FAQ; shopcummins.com
templates.notes: Typical: 20-50 hr by model. Source: Cummins Onan RV Generator Handbook; Cummins.com FAQ; shopcummins.com.

templates.title: Generator oil & filter (gasoline, e.g. Onan QG)
templates.typicalRange: 100-150 hr (100 hr on some small QG 4000 units); 12 mo
templates.severeService: Dust or heat: change sooner
templates.source: Cummins Onan RV Generator Handbook; Cummins.com FAQ; shopcummins.com
templates.notes: Typical: 100-150 hr (100 hr on some small QG 4000 units); 12 mo. Severe service: Dust or heat: change sooner. Source: Cummins Onan RV Generator Handbook; Cummins.com FAQ; shopcummins.com.

templates.title: Generator oil & filter (diesel, e.g. Onan QD)
templates.notes: Typical: 150-250 hr; 12 mo. Source: shopcummins.com; Onan Handbook.

templates.title: Generator exercise under load
templates.description: Exercise. Run at least 2 hr at >=50% load each month; one 2-hr run beats several short ones.
templates.notes: Source: Onan HDZAA Operator Manual; shopcummins.com.

templates.title: Generator fuel stabilizer before storage
templates.description: Add. Before storage longer than 30 days.

templates.title: Fuel filters: primary water separator + secondary
templates.severeService: Bad fuel or water in the separator: replace sooner
templates.notes: Typical: 15,000-25,000 mi; 12 mo. Severe service: Bad fuel or water in the separator: replace sooner. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Diesel fuel filter (Sprinter)
templates.description: Replace. No generic value; use the model-year schedule.

templates.title: Automatic transmission fluid (Ford TorqShift)
templates.description: Replace. Motorhome weight and grades count as severe duty.
templates.notes: Typical: 30,000-150,000 mi; 3-5 yr. Source: Ford schedule (owner summaries); General practice.

templates.title: Allison transmission fluid (TES 295 synthetic, e.g. TranSynd)
templates.description: Replace. Diesel pushers. Allison prefers fluid analysis. Fluid that is not 100% TES 295 uses the non-TES 295 task instead.
templates.severeService: Retarder-equipped or severe vocation: 75,000 mi / 3,000 hr / 36 mo
templates.source: Allison fluid/filter recommendations (fccc247.com PDF); Foretravel/Allison data; Family RVing
templates.notes: Typical: 150,000-300,000 mi; 4,000-6,000 hr; 48 mo. Severe service: Retarder-equipped or severe vocation: 75,000 mi / 3,000 hr / 36 mo. Source: Allison fluid/filter recommendations (fccc247.com PDF); Foretravel/Allison data; Family RVing.

templates.title: Allison transmission fluid (non-TES 295: Dexron/TES 389)
templates.severeService: Severe duty: 12,000 mi / 6 mo
templates.source: Allison data as published by Foretravel
templates.notes: Severe service: Severe duty: 12,000 mi / 6 mo. Source: Allison data as published by Foretravel.

templates.title: Allison main filter, initial change
templates.source: Allison manual (as quoted by Jayco owner); Foretravel
templates.notes: Source: Allison manual (as quoted by Jayco owner); Foretravel.

templates.title: Allison filters: main/spin-on + lube
templates.source: Allison manual (as quoted by Jayco owner); Foretravel
templates.notes: Source: Allison manual (as quoted by Jayco owner); Foretravel.

templates.title: Rear axle lube check
templates.description: Inspect. Check at each oil change.

templates.title: Rear axle lube replacement
templates.severeService: Towing: sooner
templates.notes: Severe service: Towing: sooner. Source: Ford schedule (owner summaries).

templates.title: Transmission fluid (van chassis)
templates.description: Replace. Use the chassis schedule's severe-duty column.

templates.title: Brake fluid replacement
templates.description: Replace. Brake fluid absorbs moisture, so the interval is time-based.
templates.notes: Typical: 2-3 yr. Source: Ford schedule (owner summaries); General practice.

templates.title: Air tank moisture drain check
templates.description: Drain daily or weekly if there is no automatic drain valve.

templates.title: Air dryer cartridge replacement
templates.description: Replace. Moisture in the tanks means replace early.

templates.title: Air brake adjustment, slack adjusters & chambers
Tire pressure check (cold)
templates.description: Check and adjust. Set to the weighed axle load using the tire maker's load/inflation table. Check monthly in storage.

templates.title: Tire inspection: tread, sidewalls, valve stems
Tire age replacement
templates.description: Replace. Michelin: replace at 10 yr from manufacture regardless of tread, with yearly pro inspection after 5 yr. Many RV owners use 5-7 yr.
templates.typicalRange: 6-10 yr from the DOT date code
templates.source: Michelin (When to Replace Tires); RV tire literature
templates.notes: Typical: 6-10 yr from the DOT date code. Source: Michelin (When to Replace Tires); RV tire literature.

templates.title: Professional tire inspection (tires over 5 years old)
templates.source: Michelin (When to Replace Tires); RV tire literature
templates.notes: Source: Michelin (When to Replace Tires); RV tire literature.

templates.title: Lug nut re-torque after wheel mounting
templates.notes: Typical: 50-100 mi after any wheel removal. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Chassis lube: steering linkage, ball joints, driveshaft U-joints
templates.description: Grease. Older F-53 chassis have many grease points.
templates.notes: Typical: 6,000-10,000 mi; 12 mo. Source: Ford 1999-2004 motorhome chassis intervals (as reported).

templates.title: Chassis lube: kingpins, tie-rods, driveline, slack adjusters
templates.notes: Typical: 10,000-15,000 mi; 12 mo. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Power steering fluid check
templates.description: Check at each oil change; replace per OEM (~3 yr).

templates.title: Wheel alignment
templates.typicalRange: 12-24 mo; also after new tires, suspension work or uneven wear
templates.notes: Typical: 12-24 mo; also after new tires, suspension work or uneven wear. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Powered leveling jacks: inspect & lubricate
templates.description: Inspect and lubricate. Check hydraulic fluid with the jacks retracted.

templates.title: House battery water level (flooded lead-acid)
templates.description: Check. Never let lead-acid batteries sit discharged.

templates.title: Lithium battery storage charge
templates.description: Check. Store at ~50% state of charge. Don't charge below 32 deg F (0 deg C) unless the battery is self-heating.

templates.title: Roof membrane & sealant inspection: seams, vents, A/C, skylights, end caps
templates.description: Inspect. Many RV warranties hinge on documented ~90-day seal checks; photograph each inspection.
templates.notes: Typical: Every 60-90 days. Source: Camping World; RVtravel.com.

templates.title: Roof sealant touch-up
templates.description: Reseal. Use the OEM-approved sealant (self-leveling on horizontal surfaces).

templates.title: Roof cleaning & UV treatment
templates.description: Clean and protect. Use a cleaner made for the membrane (EPDM, TPO or fiberglass). Don't walk on unsupported roofs.
templates.notes: Typical: 3-4 times per year. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Roof membrane replacement / full reseal
templates.notes: Typical: ~10-20 yr membrane life. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Slide-out seals: clean & inspect
templates.description: Clean and inspect. Lippert: soap-and-water cleaning; seals need little else.
templates.notes: Source: RV Help (citing Lippert); Keystone RV.

templates.title: Exterior wash
templates.description: Clean. Monthly while in use. No pressure washing near seals.

templates.title: Entry steps, hinges, locks & compartment latches
Slide-out topper debris check before retracting
templates.notes: Source: RV Help (citing Lippert); Keystone RV.

templates.title: Slide-out mechanism lubrication (rack-and-pinion / through-frame)
templates.description: Lubricate. Dry lube per the manual. Schwintek in-wall slides take NO lubricant; branch on mechanism type.

templates.title: Awning: clean, inspect & lubricate
templates.description: Clean, inspect and lubricate. Dry fully before storage; retract in wind.

templates.title: Fresh-water system sanitize
templates.description: Sanitize. Also when de-winterizing. Common method: 1/4 cup household bleach per 15 gal of tank capacity, hold 4-12 hr, flush.

templates.title: Water filters (inline/canister)
templates.notes: Typical: 3-6 mo or per cartridge. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Water heater anode rod (Suburban steel tank)
templates.description: Inspect and replace. Replace yearly or when more than 75% consumed.
templates.source: Suburban guidance via NRVTA, RV101/Mark Polk, RV Geeks
templates.notes: Source: Suburban guidance via NRVTA, RV101/Mark Polk, RV Geeks.

templates.title: Water heater drain plug (Dometic/Atwood aluminum tank)
templates.description: Inspect and replace. Aluminum tanks have no anode; check the nylon drain plug instead.
templates.source: Suburban guidance via NRVTA, RV101/Mark Polk, RV Geeks
templates.notes: Source: Suburban guidance via NRVTA, RV101/Mark Polk, RV Geeks.

templates.title: Water heater flush (tank type)
templates.severeService: Hard water: more often
templates.notes: Severe service: Hard water: more often. Source: NRVTA; General practice.

templates.title: Water heater T&P valve, burner, igniter & flue
templates.description: Inspect and clean. Suburban T&P valves open at 210 deg F / 150 psi.

templates.title: Furnace service: burner, blower, sail switch, exhaust vent nests
templates.description: Inspect and clean. Do it before heating season.

templates.title: Roof A/C return-air filters
templates.severeService: Full-time use: every 2 weeks
templates.notes: Severe service: Full-time use: every 2 weeks. Source: General practice.

templates.description: Test. Also after any LP repair.
templates.notes: Source: NRVTA inspector account (TractorByNet); General practice.

templates.title: DOT LP cylinder requalification
templates.description: Requalify. DOT cylinders: 12 yr from manufacture, then per the requalification mark. ASME motorhome tanks differ.

templates.title: Smoke alarm test
templates.description: Test. Also test before each trip.

templates.title: Smoke alarm replacement
templates.description: Replace. Combination smoke/CO alarms: 7 yr (84 mo). RVs must carry an NFPA 1192-compliant smoke alarm.

templates.notes: Source: Camping World; RV Enthusiast; Panther RV (Safe-T-Alert).

templates.description: Inspect. Tires & lugs, fluids, lights, slides/awning stowed, jacks up, LP set correctly, detector test, tow bar/hitch if towing a car.

templates.notes: Severe service: Severe use (mud, water, sand, high RPM, heavy loads, idling, short cold trips): service at 50% of the usage interval (Polaris). Source: Polaris owner's manual (publications.polaris.com).

templates.title: Tire pressure & damage
templates.description: Check. Low pressures (~4-15 psi); check sidewalls.

templates.title: Wheel bearings
templates.severeService: After water or mud: more often
templates.notes: Severe service: After water or mud: more often. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Lug nut torque after wheel removal
templates.description: Torque on install and recheck after the first ride.

templates.title: CV boots & axles
templates.description: Inspect. Replace a torn boot quickly.

templates.title: Ball joints & tie-rod ends
templates.severeService: Severe use (mud, water, sand, high RPM, heavy loads, idling, short cold trips): service at 50% of the usage interval (Polaris)
templates.notes: Severe service: Severe use (mud, water, sand, high RPM, heavy loads, idling, short cold trips): service at 50% of the usage interval (Polaris). Source: Polaris RZR 1000 schedule (Powersports Authority).

templates.title: Grease fittings: A-arm pivots, trailing arms, driveshaft U-joints, prop shaft
templates.severeService: After every mud or water ride
templates.notes: Severe service: After every mud or water ride. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Battery
templates.description: Test. Keep on a maintainer in storage.

templates.title: Pre-ride inspection
templates.description: Inspect. Fluid levels, controls, brakes, tires, lights, CV boots, belts/harnesses, air box.

templates.title: Winch, rope/cable, hook & fairlead
templates.description: Inspect. Synthetic rope: check UV and abrasion. Steel cable: kinks and broken strands. Full inspection every 6 mo.

templates.title: Post-submersion / deep-mud service
templates.description: Inspect and replace. Check the air box, drain the CVT housing, check diffs and gearcase for water, grease all fittings, inspect wheel bearings.
templates.notes: Source: General practice; Polaris severe-use rule.

templates.title: Storage prep
templates.description: Prepare. Stabilize fuel, change oil, battery on maintainer, rodent-proofing.

templates.title: First service (Yamaha)
templates.description: Replace and inspect. Oil and filter; inspect hoses, clamps and fasteners.
templates.notes: Source: Yamaha 2025 VX Owner's Manual chart.

templates.title: First service (Kawasaki)
templates.description: Replace and inspect. Inspect all hoses, clamps, nuts, bolts and fasteners.

templates.title: First service (Sea-Doo)
templates.description: Replace and inspect. 1630 ACE-300 per the shop manual; some 2020 guides state 100 hr / 1 yr.
templates.notes: Source: BRP Sea-Doo shop manual summary.

templates.title: Engine oil & filter (Yamaha, Kawasaki)
templates.source: Yamaha WaveRunners 'Maintenance Matters'; Kawasaki Ultra 310 Owner's Manual
templates.notes: Source: Yamaha WaveRunners 'Maintenance Matters'; Kawasaki Ultra 310 Owner's Manual.

templates.title: Spark plugs
templates.description: Replace. Kawasaki Ultra 310: NGK PMR9B; don't adjust the gap.
templates.source: Sea-Doo Operator's Guides (as summarized); Kawasaki manual
templates.notes: Typical: ~100-200 hr. Source: Sea-Doo Operator's Guides (as summarized); Kawasaki manual.

templates.title: Anticorrosion spray (engine compartment)
templates.description: Protect. Sea-Doo: every 10 hr in saltwater use.
templates.notes: Source: BRP Sea-Doo shop manual summary.

templates.title: Oil-injection reservoir & lines check (2-stroke)
templates.description: Check. A failed injection line or pump can seize the engine; many owners convert to premix.

templates.title: Oil-injection hoses & filter replacement (2-stroke)
templates.description: Replace as they age; no fixed interval found.

templates.title: Closed-loop coolant (Sea-Doo)
templates.description: Replace. Yamaha and Kawasaki use open-loop (raw-water) cooling with no coolant to change.
templates.notes: Source: Sea-Doo Operator's Guides / shop manual.

templates.title: Freshwater cooling-system flush
templates.description: Flush. After every saltwater or dirty-water ride. Don't pressure-wash the engine bay.
templates.notes: Source: Yamaha 2025 VX manual; Kawasaki manual.

templates.title: Supercharger inspection (Sea-Doo 1630 ACE)
templates.description: Inspect. BRP calls it maintenance-free but says to inspect every 200 hr under intense use. If the engine floods, remove the supercharger and flush its bearings.
templates.notes: Source: BRP MY2018 RXP-X 300 spec sheet.

templates.title: Supercharger rebuild (Sea-Doo 1503 4-TEC, 2003-2015)
templates.description: Rebuild and inspect. Clutch-washer failure can destroy the engine. Aftermarket consensus, not OEM-verified; some cite 200 hr after the 2012 washer update.
templates.notes: Source: Greenhulk / Watercraft Journal; Steveninsales; PWCParts.

templates.title: Supercharger oiling after riding (Kawasaki)
templates.description: Lubricate. At the end of each day's use, spray fogging oil ~10 sec at idle to prevent mineral deposits; critical after saltwater.
templates.notes: Source: Kawasaki Ultra 310 Owner's Manual p.142.

templates.title: Supercharger service (Yamaha SVHO)
templates.description: Inspect. No published rebuild interval was found.
templates.source: Yamaha FX SHO service manual (chart row)
templates.notes: Source: Yamaha FX SHO service manual (chart row).

templates.title: Intercooler flush
templates.description: Flush. After saltwater or dirty-water rides. Kawasaki has a separate intercooler flush port.

templates.title: Drive shaft, coupler & intermediate housing grease
Carbon ring & drive shaft boot (Sea-Doo)
templates.description: Inspect. Water in the hull is a cue to check.
templates.source: BRP shop manual (row listed); General practice
templates.notes: Source: BRP shop manual (row listed); General practice.

templates.title: Impeller & wear ring inspection
templates.description: Inspect. Loss of hook-up or top speed is a cue to check.
templates.severeService: Sand or rocky shorelines: sooner
templates.notes: Typical: 50-100 hr. Severe service: Sand or rocky shorelines: sooner. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Jet pump bearings, seals & pump oil
templates.description: Inspect and grease. Kawasaki: first at 25 hr, then every 50 hr; service before long storage. Yamaha: check bearing grease condition.
templates.source: Kawasaki Ultra 310 manual (p.30, as summarized); Yamaha VX chart
templates.notes: Source: Kawasaki Ultra 310 manual (p.30, as summarized); Yamaha VX chart.

templates.title: Intake grate, ride plate & pump housing
templates.description: Inspect and clean. Clear debris after each ride.

templates.title: Battery
templates.description: Test. Keep on a maintainer in storage.

templates.title: Anodes
templates.severeService: Saltwater: monthly (Sea-Doo)
templates.notes: Severe service: Saltwater: monthly (Sea-Doo). Source: BRP Sea-Doo shop manual summary.

templates.title: Hull bottom, sponsons, bond line, bilge & drain plugs
templates.description: Inspect and clean. Full inspection yearly.

templates.title: Lanyard / safety key & kill switch test
Life jackets: one per rider
templates.description: Inspect. Most inflatable life jackets are not rated for PWC use.

templates.title: Fire extinguisher check: gauge, pin, nozzle
templates.source: USCG fire extinguisher FAQ (uscgboating.org); Oregon State Marine Board
templates.notes: Source: USCG fire extinguisher FAQ (uscgboating.org); Oregon State Marine Board.

templates.title: Fire extinguisher retirement (disposable)
templates.description: Replace. USCG rule effective April 20, 2022. Boats under 26 ft from model year 2018 on need unexpired 5-B/20-B units.
templates.source: USCG fire extinguisher FAQ (uscgboating.org); Oregon State Marine Board
templates.notes: Source: USCG fire extinguisher FAQ (uscgboating.org); Oregon State Marine Board.

templates.title: Life jackets: annual inspection (fit, fabric, buckles)
templates.notes: Source: USCG Boater's Guide; West Marine.

templates.title: Registration / documentation renewal
templates.description: Renew. Renewal cycles vary by state (1-3 yr).
templates.notes: Defaults to yearly; change it to your state's renewal cycle. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Trailer wheel bearing repack
templates.description: Repack. Boat trailers: at least every 12 mo regardless of miles. Bearing protectors need top-ups but don't replace a repack.
templates.source: Dexter manuals; Dexter Group (Proper Bearing Lubrication Type); Loyal Axles
templates.notes: Uses the time limit only; this type doesn't log miles in the app. Source: Dexter manuals; Dexter Group (Proper Bearing Lubrication Type); Loyal Axles.

templates.title: Trailer bearing repack after immersion (axles without E-Z Lube)
templates.description: Repack. Dexter: these axles aren't designed for immersion; repack after each immersion.
templates.source: Dexter manuals; Dexter Group (Proper Bearing Lubrication Type); Loyal Axles
templates.notes: Source: Dexter manuals; Dexter Group (Proper Bearing Lubrication Type); Loyal Axles.

templates.title: Surge brake inspection: master cylinder fluid, actuator, lockout
Rinse trailer brakes after saltwater launch
Trailer electric brake shoe adjustment
templates.notes: This type doesn't log miles in the app, so it uses a yearly reminder instead of 3,000 mi. Source: Dexter Axle manuals.

templates.title: Trailer electric brakes: magnets, shoes, drums & wiring
templates.notes: Uses the time limit only; this type doesn't log miles in the app. Source: Dexter Axle manuals.

templates.title: Trailer lug nut re-torque after wheel mounting (10 mi)
templates.description: Torque. Then at 25 and 50 mi; star pattern.

templates.title: Trailer lug nut re-torque after wheel mounting (25 mi)
Trailer lug nut re-torque after wheel mounting (50 mi)
Trailer tire age replacement
templates.description: Replace. Small 8-13 in. trailer tires age fast.
templates.typicalRange: 5-7 yr from the DOT date code
templates.notes: Typical: 5-7 yr from the DOT date code. Source: etrailer.

templates.title: Coupler, safety chains, winch strap & bow stop
Winch strap replacement
templates.notes: Typical: ~3-5 yr (UV); sooner if frayed. Source: General practice.

templates.title: Pre-ride check
templates.description: Inspect. Drain plugs in, intake clear, fuel and oil level, battery, steering and throttle, kill switch, safety gear.

templates.title: Winterization
templates.description: Flush, fog, stabilize fuel, change oil. Yamaha/Kawasaki open loop: drain and blow out. Sea-Doo closed loop: verify antifreeze.

templates.title: Spring commissioning
templates.description: Inspect and test. Battery, hoses and clamps, pump and intake, safety-gear dates, kill switch test.
